summary.name: Clementine
summary.one_liner: Clementine is a cross-platform music player and library organizer, inspired by Amarok 1.4, that plays local files, internet radio, and cloud or streaming sources.
use_cases: Playing and searching a local music library
Streaming from Plex or Subsonic servers
Syncing podcasts and copying music to portable players
summary.what_it_does: Clementine searches and plays a local music library and can play internet radio from several services, including SomaFM, Digitally Imported and Icecast. It can also browse music from Jamendo, Magnatune, Subsonic and Plex servers, and play songs stored on Box, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive and Seafile. Playlist features include smart and dynamic playlists, tabbed playlists, and import/export of M3U, XSPF, PLS, ASX and WPL. Other features include tag editing, MusicBrainz tag fetching, album art download, lyrics display, transcoding, podcast syncing via gpodder.net, and remote control from Android, iOS, or the command line.
notable: Plays from many streaming and cloud sources, including Plex, Subsonic and Dropbox
Remote control from Android, iPhone/iPad, Wii Remote, MPRIS or command line
Inspired by Amarok 1.4 with a focus on fast search and playback
Supports Google Cast devices and projectM visualisations
caveats: Pricing not stated on the page; listed as free based on the listing context only, not explicitly on the page
Clementine Remote for Android is distributed via Google Play; the page mentions a beta program for development builds
